description:
Omega Yang, who has a special constitution that makes it difficult for him to lead a normal life due to the heat cycle that explodes without warning. In the end, he is unable to control his pheromones and gets fired from the company by CEO Jin Se-Ryuk. While he is sobbing and drinking to calm his mind, he catches a taxi that is passing by in a hurry due to the heat cycle that explodes again . For some reason, he gets excited by the alpha pheromones that fill the car. Unable to distinguish that the person in front of him is not a taxi driver but Se-Ryuk, he ends up asking for a favor that he shouldn't do...

*"Sir, can you help me."*

(Source: Mr.Blue, translated)
